meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 在每次成功编辑后会自动收到 comment-checker 对注释的检查结果;遇到警告时,会先修复或解释被点名的注释,然后才继续后续任务。
howto.when: 当 Claude 刚完成 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑动作,并且 comment-checker 返回了注释警告时,会被这次反馈拦住,要求先处理警告;非编辑动作不会触发。

say.text: 修复刚才 comment-checker 点名的注释,然后继续。
say.note: Claude 会改掉那处注释,然后继续后续工作。

say.text: 为什么这条注释会被 comment-checker 标记?
say.note: Claude 会说明那处注释为什么被标记为警告。

say.text: 刚收到的注释警告要怎么处理才不卡进度?
say.note: Claude 会选择修复或解释警告,解除阻断后继续。

howto.what_en: After a successful edit, Claude automatically gets comment-checker results for comments. If it flags a warning, the feedback blocks progress, so Claude must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a successful edit (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) is followed by comment-checker warning feedback. Non-edit tools don't trigger it; missing checker binaries produce no output.

say_en.text: Fix the comment comment-checker just flagged, then continue.
say_en.note: Claude edits the comment and continues with the task.

say_en.text: Why was this comment flagged? Explain it to me.
say_en.note: Claude explains the warning and suggests how to handle it.

say_en.text: How should I handle the comment warning we got?
say_en.note: Claude will resolve the warning by fixing or explaining it.
